faq.q: What have houses in Silver Valley, Maple Ridge sold for?

items.t: 64 houses sold in Silver Valley, Maple Ridge at a median of $1,421,500 (middle half $1,290,750 to $1,615,500). A typical house in Silver Valley, Maple Ridge spent 31 days on the market and closed at 97.8% of the asking price.

In Silver Valley, Maple Ridge, townhomes sold at a median of $805,000 across 24 sales, and the middle half closed between $756,250 and $879,900. The median townhome sat 18 days and sold for 98.8% of list.

blocks.text: Source: Paragon closed sales, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026; medians need 5 or more sales.
How Silver Valley compares with the rest of Maple Ridge

items.t: Houses in Silver Valley have the highest median of the 9 Maple Ridge sub-areas, $1,421,500, ahead of Thornhill at $1,292,250; the lowest is Southwest Maple Ridge at $1,039,000.

Townhomes in Silver Valley have the second highest median of 8 Maple Ridge sub-areas, $805,000. Southwest Maple Ridge is lowest at $610,000 and Thornhill highest at $862,000. Cottonwood ($750,000) sits just below and Thornhill ($862,000) sits just above.

blocks.text: By build year, townhomes are the newest homes selling in Silver Valley, Maple Ridge (median 2017) and houses the oldest (median 2013), a gap of 4 years.
